name: Mercenary Comet
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Comet (players/sorcerer/mercenary/comet_merc.sval, 12 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 6 (in brackets): cast point 0.2 s (0.25 s); freeze 2 s (2.25 s; HoH1's own text says 2.25). Its own mana 50, cooldown 0.4 s. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Comet lands sooner (0.2 s cast point) for 240 hybrid damage split among the enemies hit, who freeze for 2 s.
